subject: The one mistake that makes this app useless
preview_text: I discovered a simple 3-minute routine that separates the winners from the rest. Are you making this error?
body_paragraphs: Truth time. Most people open this app, glance at a prediction, and place a bet. That's it. They treat it like a magic 8-ball. And then they wonder why they still lose. The secret isn't the AI. It's the 3 minutes you spend *before* you even look at a pick.

The sharpest punters I know have a non-negotiable morning ritual. They don't just consume data; they build context. It's the consistency that turns random insights into a winning identity. They check one thing first, every single day, to prime their brain. This routine makes every confidence score and speed rating 10x more meaningful because you understand the 'why' behind the AI's call.

This is why the 'Daily Racecard Digest' is the most powerful—and most skipped—feature. It's not just a list. It's a curated, 3-minute briefing on the key variables that changed overnight: a jockey swap on a favourite, a sudden track condition shift, a trainer's last-minute entry. The AI recalculates everything at dawn. This is your first look.

Open the app right now. Before you do anything else, tap 'Daily Digest'. Spend three minutes. That's all. This small habit is what separates the pros from the hopefuls. P.S. The users who do this daily are the ones who message me about turning their first $5 free credit into a real track payout. They saw the pattern first.
